title: Anywhere and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：anywhere　|　正文 308 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anywhere 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Anywhere, in 1983 the painter carried the brush at the easel, and everybody in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the painter had carried the brush ② anywhere on the same day, and nobody had asked a single question. The painter had come to the studio two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the studio he had left behind him.

The catalogue for May 1977 puts it plainer. The brush was ③ anywhere, and the visitor who kept it wrote of the brush ④ anywhere in the same line; nothing in the studio was ever left anywhere for long in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ anywhere, and ⑥ Anywhere came the visitor who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the studio had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was that the brush be kept ⑦ anywhere at the easel, and that everybody be ⑧ anywhere before the May rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried anywhere.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993 she carried the brush  anywhere before dawn when nobody else would, and  Anywhere, she said in 1995, that was the part the studio never forgot; the catalogue still speaks of it anywhere. She kept the brush in the same easel for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the studio never forgot how anywhere it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在任何地方（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the brush anywhere，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在任何地方（作表语，说明处所或去向：the brush was anywhere）
C. adv. 到任何地方（置于句首：Anywhere, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 到任何地方（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the brush anywhere）
E. adv. 到任何地方（作介词宾语：from anywhere）
F. adv. 到任何地方（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Anywhere came the visitor）
G. adv. 在任何地方（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be kept anywhere at the easel）
H. adv. 在任何地方（be anywhere 说明所在或去向：everybody be anywhere before the rains）

answers.why: anywhere 意为“到任何地方”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Anywhere, in 1983 …。
anywhere 意为“在任何地方”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the brush anywhere。
anywhere 意为“在任何地方”，此处作表语说明那件小小的画笔的去向或所在：was anywhere。
anywhere 意为“到任何地方”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the brush anywhere。
anywhere 意为“到任何地方”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from anywhere。
anywhere 意为“到任何地方”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Anywhere came the visitor。
anywhere 意为“在任何地方”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be kept anywhere at the easel。
anywhere 意为“在任何地方”，be anywhere 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
